hints.title: Bitwise AND Non-Increasing Property
hints.text: Taking the bitwise and of additional elements can only decrease or preserve values, never increase them.

hints.title: Global Minimum Score
hints.text: If the bitwise and of the entire array is greater than 0, any split into multiple subarrays will strictly increase total score, so return 1.

hints.title: Greedy Zero Segmenting
hints.text: If total and equals 0, greedily accumulate running bitwise and until it hits 0, incrementing subarray count and resetting the mask.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass accumulating running bitwise AND.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Notice that minimum possible score is the total AND, and greedy 0-segmentation is optimal.
